tokens.name: sheet-deep
tokens.usage: The deepest step of the ground ladder: inset sections and the strip beyond the sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-wash
tokens.usage: Card and panel surface, one step up from sheet. Panels and cards take this fill and a hairline.

tokens.name: sheet-wash-light
tokens.usage: Inset chips, disabled surfaces and neutral containers sitting on a panel.

tokens.name: sheet-mid
tokens.usage: The middle step of the ground ladder: overlays and dialogs.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Page ground. The base every layout sits on; body text and ink read on it.

tokens.name: sheet-raised
tokens.usage: Raised elements above an overlay: menus, the control bar, toasts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: ground-lit
tokens.usage: Lighting radial of the sheet ground (upper left).

tokens.name: ground-shade
tokens.usage: Lighting radial of the sheet ground (lower right).

tokens.name: ground-glow
tokens.usage: Lighting radial of the sheet ground (upper right).

tokens.name: ground-pool
tokens.usage: Lighting radial of the sheet ground (lower left).

tokens.name: ground-vignette
tokens.usage: Fall-off at the left and right edges of the sheet only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the strongest line, on sheet, sheet-wash and sheet-raised. Headings are always ink.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running prose on sheet and sheet-wash.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono labels on sheet and sheet-wash; disabled labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Section rules, strong hairlines and control borders. Never text.

tokens.name: ink-hair
tokens.usage: Panel borders and the faintest rules. Never text.

tokens.name: ink-drafted
tokens.usage: The fill inside the outlined display lockup; the stroke is ink.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Margin notes and the signature, set in the hand face.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The rule of an approval stamp and graphic marks. Never lettering: use stamp-ink.

tokens.name: stamp-ink
tokens.usage: Lettering on a stamp.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Reserved. The system draws rings and rules, not shadows.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: A wash behind recessed content.

tokens.name: rule-major
tokens.usage: The blueprint grid, major lines. Painted only on the ground, never behind text.

tokens.name: rule-minor
tokens.usage: The blueprint grid, minor lines. Painted only on the ground, never behind text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one primary colour, heritage river. Fills primary buttons and underlines links; text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Never removed.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: Dusk, depth, the dyer's craft. Named for Indigofera, West Africa textile tradition. Used for twilight surfaces, deep atmosphere, mini-app moods. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: savanna
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: Sun-dried grass, open land, the dry season. Named for Sub-Saharan grasslands. Used for warm grassland surfaces, daylight atmosphere. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: baobab
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: The tree of life, age, shelter. Named for Adansonia, across the African continent. Used for earthy surfaces, grounded atmosphere, bark tones. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: sunset
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: Day's end, warmth, the gathering hour. Named for The African horizon at dusk. Used for warm accent surfaces, golden-hour atmosphere. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: Flow, life, the journey. Named for The great African rivers — Zambezi, Nile, Congo. Used for cool surfaces, flowing atmosphere, water tones. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: hematite
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: Foundation, endurance, the substrate. Named for Sishen & Thabazimbi, South Africa. Used for neutral anchor, mini-app surfaces, atmosphere. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: kalahari
tokens.usage: Heritage tone: Openness, space, the light pole. Named for Kalahari & Namib, Southern Africa. Used for light anchor, warm backgrounds, mini-app surfaces. A mark or surface tone, not body text.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Experimental family: a colour for each theme and no origin or meaning yet. Use for marks and fills in experiments only; not body text.

tokens.name: acacia
tokens.usage: Experimental family: a colour for each theme and no origin or meaning yet. Use for marks and fills in experiments only; not body text.

tokens.usage: Experimental family: a colour for each theme and no origin or meaning yet. Use for marks and fills in experiments only; not body text.

tokens.name: storm
tokens.usage: Experimental family: a colour for each theme and no origin or meaning yet. Use for marks and fills in experiments only; not body text.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: Experimental family: a colour for each theme and no origin or meaning yet. Use for marks and fills in experiments only; not body text.

tokens.name: protea
tokens.usage: Experimental family: a colour for each theme and no origin or meaning yet. Use for marks and fills in experiments only; not body text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The home page lockup. Uppercase; each line drafted, the second outlined.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: H2 of a section, in ink with the mineral as a rule beneath.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: H3 of a card; ink, with a mineral rule under it.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: A pull quote, set against a mineral rule.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The paragraph under a section title.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label. 700, because dark text on river asks 15px at 700 but 16.5px at 600.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Captions, figure tags and key terms. Uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above a section title. Uppercase, with a rule running out from it.

styles.name: margin-note
styles.usage: A margin note or the signature, in pencil.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps and label offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; list rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inline padding; control bar padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap before a card grid; section inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page-header spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The largest step.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Between a hairline and a label; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Compact control padding.

tokens.name: space-3-5
tokens.usage: Compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6-5
tokens.usage: Between a section lede and its content.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls and inset chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Mid-size containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. Every card takes this.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (always pills), toggles, the skip link and the control bar.

marks.note: Sizes and weights that are not colour, type or space but are shared.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Mono label size, always with label-weight (600). 15px at 600 clears APCA on ink; at 400 it asks 16.5px.

tokens.name: label-lg
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and larger mono labels.

tokens.name: label-weight
tokens.usage: Weight of every mono label. Dropping to 400 is a contrast regression.

tokens.name: mineral-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of every mineral mark: the rule under a heading, the swatch bar, the rail.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Prose width. 100%: text fills its container.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Prose width for larger type. 100%.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: The blueprint grid, minor pitch.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: The blueprint grid, major pitch.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Button label and the larger mono label. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running prose. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-card
tokens.usage: Text inside a card. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-lede
tokens.usage: The paragraph under a section title. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-h3
tokens.usage: Card and item titles; margin notes. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: A pull quote and sub-titles. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-section
tokens.usage: A section title at its largest. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-fluid-section
tokens.usage: A section title, fluid. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-fluid-display
tokens.usage: The home lockup, fluid. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-fluid-page
tokens.usage: A page header title, fluid. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-fluid-sub
tokens.usage: The hero proposition, fluid. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-fluid-big
tokens.usage: A large statement, fluid. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: text-fluid-pull
tokens.usage: A pull quote, fluid. Nothing sits below `label`: APCA sets the floor.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: A hover. Stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-normal
tokens.usage: A state change. Stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: A hairline or a mineral rule drawing itself. Stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-page
tokens.usage: A page unrolling. Stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Just above the ground.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: The page content, above the ground layers.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The skip link and anything that must sit over the header.
